protocol.deadline: one release period, release-relative, includes maintenance
protocol.monitoring_treatment: combined resource-monitor configuration (process-tree sampler, tegrastats, logging, serialization and interval-periodic guards); not unmonitored performance
protocol.rate_denominator: completed requests divided by worker active elapsed time (finished_ns - started_ns)
protocol.replication: independent runs, not requests; n=3 per primary condition
protocol.sampling_caveat: 2,000 ms sampling can miss short-lived peaks; resource peaks are observational only
